items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I know that later in your career you worked with Louig Armstrong.

ctx.x: I know that later in your career you worked with Louig Armstrong. What about the difference in the music of Armstrong and Ellington?

Well, that's two different styles of music, to begin with. And Ellington has got a large band, Louie had a seven piece band, which -- and, to be truthful, I enjoyed both bands but I enjoyed Louig's more because I had more freedom in my playing, where Duke, you got to play what you see on the paper plus what you would say freedom, but it wasn't that much freedom. It doesn't give you a chance to even concentrate on really what you want to do because it's so short.
